head.text: The palette is four base colors and one accent color. Text is set in ink, paper, or titanium. Every hairline is the text color at a lower opacity. The accent appears on small elements such as active states and diagram highlights. It is never a fill for large areas. Depth comes from lines and texture. Shadows are not used.

body.svg:
<svg class="dia" viewBox="0 0 1326 84" aria-hidden="true">
            <rect x="0" y="0" width="221" height="40" fill="var(--ink)"></rect>
            <rect x="221" y="0" width="221" height="40" fill="var(--ink)" fill-opacity="0.63"></rect>
            <rect x="442" y="0" width="221" height="40" fill="var(--ink)" fill-opacity="0.45"></rect>
            <rect x="663" y="0" width="221" height="40" fill="var(--ink)" fill-opacity="0.27"></rect>
            <rect x="884" y="0" width="221" height="40" fill="var(--ink)" fill-opacity="0.11"></rect>
            <rect x="1105" y="0" width="221" height="40" fill="var(--ink)" fill-opacity="0.06"></rect>
            <rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="1325" height="39" fill="none" class="hair" stroke-width="1"></rect>
            <text x="0" y="78">Ink 100%</text>
            <text x="221" y="78">Body text 63%</text>
            <text x="442" y="78">Labels 45%</text>
            <text x="663" y="78">Quiet text 27%</text>
            <text x="884" y="78">Hairline 11%</text>
            <text x="1105" y="78">Soft hairline 6%</text>
          </svg>

body.text: The opacity steps are the same in both themes and are drawn here in the current theme's ink. The site currently uses three blues: #2f5ce0 in the landing engine, #3b82f6 in the docs, #2563eb on the blog. One should be chosen before the handoff.
